usage_guide.title: {title}: Usage guide
usage_guide.open_html: Double-click `{html_name}` and open it in a modern browser.
usage_guide.embedded: The page logic, Leaflet runtime, styles, and business geometry are embedded in one HTML file.
usage_guide.online_basemap: Online basemaps ({basemaps}) load when a network is available; business geometry, search, filters, and layer controls continue to work offline.
usage_guide.offline: The current configuration does not require an online basemap.
usage_guide.portable: `map_spec.json` and `data/` form a portable rebuild bundle.
usage_guide.record_only: `map_spec.json` is a build record; source paths remain relative to the original specification directory, so an independent rebuild is not guaranteed.
usage_guide.inspection: `inspection.json` records input layers, field candidates, CRS, and the template recommendation.
usage_guide.report: `build_report.json` records feature counts, geometry repairs, generated IDs, warnings, and output hashes.
usage_guide.verify: Run `interactive-map-builder verify --dist <this-directory>` to verify the deliverable.

landing.page_title: Interactive Map Builder — spatial data to polished map products
landing.description: Turn existing spatial data into searchable, layer-aware, presentation-ready interactive map products with a deterministic Agent workflow.
landing.eyebrow: AN AGENT SKILL FOR MAP DELIVERY
landing.hero_title: Spatial data in. Map product out.
landing.hero_body: Turn existing spatial data into searchable, filterable, layer-aware interactive maps, save key views for presentation, and export report or publication figures from the same visual plan.
landing.capabilities_title: Explore, focus, and present spatial data through one interactive map.
landing.capabilities_body: The interface stays map-first: find objects, switch spatial context, save important positions, and hand off one portable deliverable.
capabilities: Find records by name or attributes, filter categories and numeric ranges, sort results, and inspect feature details.
Move between a neutral overview and layer-focused exploration while controlling visibility, legends, and basemaps independently.
Save up to eight named center-and-zoom views in the browser and jump back to key sites during exploration and presentation.
Deliver a self-contained HTML map and generate slide or publication figures from the same visual plan.
landing.demo_eyebrow: TWO MAP PRODUCTS · REAL GENERATED HTML
landing.demo_title: Choose the interaction model that matches the task.
landing.demo_body: Both demos are generated by the repository engine from fixed NYC Open Data snapshots and embedded directly as current product outputs.
landing.map_list_body: Search, filter, sort, compare KPI summaries, and inspect individual records through linked list and map interactions.
landing.multilayer_body: Start from Overview, focus a searchable layer, control visibility independently, inspect context, and save key map views for presentation.
landing.journey_title: Move from the whole map to the places that matter.
landing.journey_body: Saved Views connects broad exploration, site inspection, and presentation: explore the whole map, inspect a site in context, then return to that exact position while presenting.
journey: Search records, switch layers, filter the current dataset, and understand the overall spatial pattern.
Zoom to a site, compare nearby layers, and keep the map as the primary surface for understanding spatial context.
Save named center-and-zoom positions, jump back to Overview or a site, and keep the presentation flow moving.
landing.workflow_title: The product experience sits on an auditable build path.
landing.workflow_body: The Agent interprets intent and confirms build-critical choices; MapSpec records the contract; the deterministic engine handles data, rendering, browser checks, and delivery verification.
steps: Discover layers, geometry, CRS, field roles, and blocking issues.
Confirm the build-critical details that remain unresolved after inspection.
Apply geometry-aware, density-aware visual defaults while preserving explicit choices.
Create the self-contained Leaflet map and requested report figures.
Exercise browser behavior, counts, hashes, provenance, and the final delivery manifest.
landing.cta_title: Try the product, then inspect the implementation.
landing.cta_body: Open either live map to experience the current product surface, or go to GitHub for the Agent Skill, MapSpec contract, tests, and release history.
